results.title: OpenAI rogue agent breach of Hugging Face - Wikipedia
results.description: Hugging Face contained the breach of its infrastructure and publicly disclosed it. Of the at least 1,200 agents involved, 95% ran on a model referred to by OpenAI as "Internal Model 1". OpenAI subsequently claimed to have restricted its use. The remaining 5% ran on GPT-5.6 Sol.
